result.title: Shaping AI's Beliefs Before It Generates: Human Sense of Agency in Creative AI
result.comment: The Proactive Co-Creator (PaCC) can be accessed at https://proactive-co-creator.github.io/. Accepted at Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026) Creative AI Track
result.summary: AI systems for creative media generation expand human capabilities yet risk diminishing human agency. A core problem is anchoring, where the user's thinking becomes anchored to a polished, generated artifact, shifting the user's role from active authoring to reactive editing. We propose pre-generation belief controls that can empower creators to inspect, revise, and steer the AI's interpretation before any media is generated, so that the initial anchor is set by the human. We formalize four design principles and instantiate them in the Proactive Co-Creator (PaCC), a system for early-stage conceptual ideation and prototyping that proactively surfaces its assumptions and uncertainty through clarifications, belief graphs, and media attributes, inviting users to shape the AI's beliefs before generating the final outcome. Using PaCC as a design probe in a small-scale, single-arm exploratory user study, we observed that participants reported directionally positive sense of agency and process control relative to their familiar prompt-based AI tools, noting that surfaced assumptions helped them think through details they had overlooked, whereas their feelings about ownership and authorship diverged

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出「生成前信念控制」的四条设计原则并实现 PaCC 系统，通过澄清提问、信念图和媒体属性在生成前显式呈现 AI 的假设与不确定性，并用小规模单臂探索性用户研究考察创作者的能动感与过程控制。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作把模型对任务的理解与不确定性外化为用户可检查、可修改的信念图，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的可读性、以及何时澄清或继续获取证据（LOOK/STOP）的问题表述与评价提供线索；但对象是创意媒体生成而非多模态推理，需较多核查。
